idea-plugin.name: Any Progress Bar
idea-plugin.description: Twenty animated progress bar presets, from animals and everyday objects to a mail-carrying snail, a cow-abducting UFO, a racing ramen bowl, a frog wizard and a roller-skating disco duck. Includes Tung Tung Tung Sahur themes and a built-in design editor. Choose from the built-in presets or combine your own PNG, JPG and SVG object, trail and background images, colours and motion. Configure under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Any Progress Bar.
